<DOCSTRING>
Manages user data and provides functionality to check if a user is an adult or a minor.

This class is responsible for handling user data and determining the age category of users. It is instantiated by the UserService and used by the UserInterface to display user information.

Attributes:
- users (List<User>): A list of user objects managed by this class. It is initialized when the UserManager is created and can be modified by the addUser method.

@see UserService
@see UserInterface
</DOCSTRING>
